english.notes:
(i) 'Consent' to sharing of a photograph or film includes general consent covering the particular act of sharing as well as specific consent and whether a belief is reasonable is to be determined having regard to all circumstances including any steps the person has taken to ascertain whether the other person consents, see section 66B(6) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
(ii) Three other offences are available under section 66B of the Act: H101570 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state without consent; H101572 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state for the purpose of sexual gratification; H101573 - Threatening to share photograph or film of person in intimate state.(iii) Section 66C provides for exemptions to the offences under this section.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 66B(10) of this Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
